messages:
julia: Quick non-work idea — mini holiday micro-swap for remote folks: 'cozy socks + one stupid holiday gif' exchange. sign up by Fri (3 days). keep it chill, <$15, ship or send remote variant. i'll randomize pairs.
ben: love it. i'm in. fiber-optic socks? :socks: 
anya: count me. also can we have a 'no fruitcake' rule? :grimacing: 
mike: logistics q — do we share addresses publicly or DM? i can host a shipping spreadsheet.
julia: mike: please DM addresses. i'll redact and only share names + ship country in the pairing doc so only the gifter sees the address.
ops-bot: Reminder: Signup for 'cozy-socks-gif-exchange' closes in 72 hours. Use /signup-swap to join.
rachael: i can't do physical international shipping — can i send a gif pack + e-gift instead?
anya: totally fine, rachael. remote-only options encouraged. note that in your DM.
sam: i'm in but allergic to wool — marking 'no wool' and will DM specifics.
olivia: i'll curate the stupid gif library. top three options already queued. :laughing: 
ben: question — pair with someone in same timezone for a live unwrapping? :thinking:
julia: optional. i'll add a checkbox 'would like a quick video unwrap' on the signup sheet.
mike: can we set a ship-by date? suggested Dec 20 so folks get things before the 24th.
julia: ship-by Dec 20 works. final pairings posted Dec 16.
rachael: excited! thanks for organizing, julia. :sparkles: 
julia: tiny rules pinned in DM: <$15, one cozy physical thing + one silly gif (imgur/giphy link ok), mark allergies, opt-in for video unbox. see you in the thread.
ops-bot: Signup count: 8 now.
